data.name: GetDiagnostics_Title
data.value: Diagnostics

data.name: GetDiagnostics_Description
data.value: Lists the diagnostics RDCore reports, for one document (path) or for every document of the workspace (no path): each with its location, code, severity, message, help page, and whether a fix is available. Lines and columns are 1-based.

data.name: GetDiagnostics_Path
data.value: The document: a path relative to the workspace root, or absolute. Leave it out for every document of the workspace.

data.name: FindSymbol_Title
data.value: Find symbol

data.name: FindSymbol_Description
data.value: Finds the declarations of the workspace whose name matches a query (modules, procedures, variables, constants, types and their members), the best matches first, each with what declares it and where. Lines and columns are 1-based.

data.name: FindSymbol_Query
data.value: The characters a name has, in order and in any case: gtnm matches GetName.

data.name: References_Title
data.value: References

data.name: References_Description
data.value: Lists the places of the workspace that refer to the symbol named at a position: each name a rename of the symbol would rename. Lines and columns are 1-based.

data.name: References_IncludeDeclaration
data.value: Whether the names the symbol's declarations declare are listed too. True when left out.

data.name: Definition_Title
data.value: Go to definition

data.name: Definition_Description
data.value: Says where the symbol named at a position is defined in the workspace. A symbol of a library is defined in no document. Lines and columns are 1-based.

data.name: Position_Path
data.value: The document: a path relative to the workspace root, or absolute.

data.name: Position_Line
data.value: The line of the position, from 1.

data.name: Position_Column
data.value: The column of the position, from 1, anywhere in the name.

data.name: NoDiagnostics
data.value: No diagnostics.

data.name: NoSymbols
data.value: No symbol matches the query.

data.name: NoLocations
data.value: Nothing found: no name is written there, or what it refers to is not known.

data.name: FixAvailable
data.value: fix available

data.name: NoSuchDocument
data.value: The workspace has no document '{0}'.

data.name: PositionNotValid
data.value: Lines and columns count from 1.

data.name: WorkspaceLoading
data.value: The workspace is still loading. Call the tool again in a moment.

data.name: NotAdvertised
data.value: The client did not advertise the '{0}' platform capability.

data.name: DescribeAt_Title
data.value: Describe what is at a position

data.name: DescribeAt_Description
data.value: Says what is written at a position: the symbol the name there refers to (its declaration, kind, scope, declared type, where it is defined and how it is used) and the innermost expression (its classification, declared type, binding and constant value). Lines and columns are 1-based.

data.name: Outline_Title
data.value: Outline a module

data.name: Outline_Description
data.value: Lists what a document's module declares, in the order it is written: each member with its kind, access, declared type and range. A property's accessors are one entry; an enumeration's constants and a user-defined type's members are the children of its entry. Lines and columns are 1-based.

data.name: NothingDescribed
data.value: Nothing is known of what is written there: no name or expression, or code the environment host has not analyzed.

data.name: DefinedAt
data.value: Defined at {0}.

data.name: ExpressionOfType
data.value: Expression at {0}: {1}, of type {2}.

data.name: Expression
data.value: Expression at {0}: {1}.

data.name: ConstantValue
data.value: Constant value: {0} ({1}).

data.name: NoOutline
data.value: The document has no outline: it could not be parsed.

data.name: DeclaresNothing
data.value: The module declares nothing.

data.name: ListFixes_Title
data.value: List fixes

data.name: ListFixes_Description
data.value: Lists the fixes of a document: the quick fixes of its diagnostics, and, for a range, the refactorings of the code there. Each fix has a fixId that preview_fix and apply_fix take, as long as the document is not changed.

data.name: ListFixes_Line
data.value: The line the range starts on, from 1; omitted for every diagnostic of the document.

data.name: ListFixes_Column
data.value: The column the range starts at, from 1; omitted for the start of the line.

data.name: ListFixes_EndLine
data.value: The line the range ends on, from 1; omitted for a range that ends on the line it starts on.

data.name: ListFixes_EndColumn
data.value: The column the range ends at, from 1; omitted for a range that ends where it starts.

data.name: NoFixes
data.value: No fixes.

data.name: FixPreferred
data.value: preferred

data.name: FixRunByCommand
data.value: run from an editor

data.name: FixFixes
data.value: fixes {0} at {1}

data.name: PreviewFix_Title
data.value: Preview a fix

data.name: PreviewFix_Description
data.value: Shows what a fix that list_fixes listed would change, as a unified diff of each document, and the questions its edit asks. Changes nothing.

data.name: Fix_FixId
data.value: The fixId of the fix, as list_fixes gave it.

data.name: FixNotFound
data.value: '{0}' is not the id of a fix: list the fixes with list_fixes.

data.name: FixStale
data.value: The document changed after the fix was listed: list the fixes again.

data.name: FixHasNoEdit
data.value: The fix '{0}' is not an edit: it runs from an editor.

data.name: FileRenamed
data.value: {0} is renamed {1}.

data.name: EditAsks
data.value: The edit asks:

data.name: ApplyFix_Title
data.value: Apply a fix

data.name: ApplyFix_Description
data.value: Applies a fix that list_fixes listed. The editor applies it, and it can be undone there. An edit that asks questions is not applied by a call with no accept: the result lists the questions, and the tool is called again with the answers.

data.name: Edit_Accept
data.value: The ids of the questions of the edit answered yes, the others being answered no; omitted to be told the questions first.

data.name: Rename_Title
data.value: Rename a symbol

data.name: Rename_Description
data.value: Renames the symbol whose name is at a position, everywhere the workspace refers to it; a module's file is renamed with it. The editor applies the rename, and it can be undone there. An edit that asks questions is not applied by a call with no accept: the result lists the questions, and the tool is called again with the answers.

data.name: Rename_NewName
data.value: The name the symbol is given.

data.name: RenameLabel
data.value: Rename to {0}

data.name: EditApplied
data.value: Applied.

data.name: EditNotAppliedAsks
data.value: Not applied: the edit asks questions first. Call the tool again with accept, the ids of the questions answered yes ([] for none).

data.name: NothingToApply
data.value: Nothing applied: the edit changes nothing, as the questions are answered.

data.name: ClientAppliesNoEdits
data.value: This client applies no edits: preview the fix with preview_fix, and apply its diff.

data.name: EditNotApplied
data.value: The editor did not apply the edit: {0}
